algorithm: Revalidate exact record graph and non-null policy graph;structural malformed values raise ValueError before assessment
Add producer errors/unavailable at record.producer;missing policy adds POLICY_UNAVAILABLE at policy
Traverse record then any supplied policy under universal checks without early exit
Require exact profile_id,run_id availability;known foreign profile adds PROFILE_ID_MISMATCH at side.profile_id
Null table adds TABLE_UNAVAILABLE;non-null table missing registered slots adds TABLE_INVENTORY_MISMATCH;still inspect all present members
Null scalar or nullable DTO adds VALUE_UNAVAILABLE at that field/root;do not invent its missing children or substitute other facts
Known original cohort revision/tree differences add COHORT_PIN_MISMATCH at the differing field;known command/cohort pair differences add COMMAND_CONTEXT_MISMATCH at command.cohort_id
Known budget0 adds LIMIT_NONPOSITIVE;known UNBOUNDED adds LIMIT_UNBOUNDED,at the value locator;either beats unknown policy/fields
Known per-command numeric limit above corresponding known batch numeric cap adds LIMIT_SCOPE_INCONSISTENT at command limit value
Known False control adds CONTROL_CLAIM_FALSE at side.controls.name.value;None remains unavailable;True is only a claim

Within a supplied side,command boundary identity equal to batch identity or reused by an earlier command in registry order adds BOUNDARY_REUSE at the later command.boundary.identity_digest;unknown identities are not equal identities
For each command,all available clock strings from batch boundary,command boundary and timing must be identical;more than one distinct known value adds CLOCK_DOMAIN_MISMATCH at command root
Known deadline<start adds TIME_ORDER_INVALID at command.timing.deadline_ns

If known command wall_limit_ns is an int>0 and start is known,checked start+limit>UInt64max adds TIME_OVERFLOW at command.timing.deadline_ns;otherwise a known unequal deadline adds DEADLINE_MISMATCH;do not use UNBOUNDED/None/0 in addition

When policy is supplied,compare corresponding known scalar values by keys,never tuple positions;unequal available values add POLICY_RECORD_MISMATCH at the record field;unknown differences add no mismatch beyond unavailable traversal
Table-shape differences are already diagnosed by universal inventory checks;compare any common present keys despite missing others;nullable DTO mismatch None is unavailable not inequality

When record.policy_digest is None add VALUE_UNAVAILABLE at record.policy_digest;when supplied policy and digest are both available compare with SHA256(canonical_policy(policy)),adding POLICY_DIGEST_MISMATCH on unequal content identity
Collect all applicable reasons,including multiple distinct codes on one field;sort/deduplicate by(code,subject);never hide known errors behind unavailable
Return derived consistency only;all fixed blockers/permissions remain regardless of empty or nonempty reason sets
assessment.comparison_fields: ALL_CORRESPONDING_FIELDS_EXCEPT_RECORD_ONLY_PRODUCER_LISTS_AND_POLICY_DIGEST;root profile_id/run_id and all nested available scalars included
